findings.summary: RFC3986 path-segment encoding is duplicated in another server utility.
findings.consequence: Future changes to path segment escaping can diverge between manifest request URLs/editor close URLs and Reader facsimile asset URLs, producing inconsistent URL handling for the same domain identity values.
findings.evidence: The owned helper at line 43 implements encodeURIComponent plus extra RFC3986 escaping. server/utils/reader-source.ts lines 210-215 contains the same helper body for facsimileImageUrl, and both helpers encode backend/work/page identity values into URL path segments.
findings.recommendation: Move the encoder to a shared URL utility and import it from both server/utils/work-manifest-client.ts and server/utils/reader-source.ts, or otherwise keep a single implementation at the boundary where these identity values become URL segments.
